procedure.startup:
printf '#!/bin/bash
exec bash /mgtools/exp_search/bin/exp_search "$@"
' > /usr/local/bin/exp_search && chmod +x /usr/local/bin/exp_search && printf '#!/bin/bash
exec bash /mgtools/exp_read/bin/exp_read "$@"
' > /usr/local/bin/exp_read && chmod +x /usr/local/bin/exp_read
dry_run_commands: exp_search "TypeError when calling a function with wrong arguments" > /tmp/mg_s.txt; cat /tmp/mg_s.txt; ID=$(grep -o 'ID: [^ ]*' /tmp/mg_s.txt | head -1 | cut -d' ' -f2); exp_read "$ID"
